variables.name: Server Port
variables.description: Port for the game server. Default SCP:SL port is 7777.

variables.name: Exiled Installation Variant
variables.description: Defines the installation option for the Exiled framework. 0 - Do not install Exiled. 1 - Install the stable release version of Exiled. 2 - Install the pre-release version of Exiled.

variables.name: Use SCPDiscord?
variables.description: Toggle to use the SCPDiscord plugin. Set to 1 to download it during server installation and run it on server start. Set to 0 to skip downloading during installation and prevent it from starting.

variables.name: Beta name
variables.description: Specifies the SteamCMD beta branch name for the server installation. Enter the name of the desired beta branch to use. Use public to select the public branch.

variables.name: Beta password
variables.description: Specifies the SteamCMD beta password for the server installation. Enter the password required to access the selected beta branch. Use none if no password is required.
